title: Time bound from logarithmic space
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $f$ map binary words to binary words, and let $c\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every binary input $x$, $M$ halts with output $f(x)$ after some number of steps and uses at most $c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$ work-tape cells. Then $M$ computes $f$ within the time bound $T(n)=((|Q|+1)\,2\,2^{5kc+3k})(n+1)^{5kc+1}$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes and $Q$ is the state set of $M$.
